dispersion_measure.description: The dispersion measure is the integrated column density of free electrons along the line of sight, measured in cm⁻³ pc.

redshift.description: Redshift is the fractional shift in the wavelength of spectral lines due to cosmic expansion, a dimensionless quantity.

flux.description: Flux is the energy received per unit time per unit area per unit frequency, measured in Jy.

fluence.description: Fluence is the time-integrated flux of a transient event, measured in Jy ms.

luminosity.description: Luminosity is the total power radiated by a source, measured in erg s⁻¹.

distance.description: Distance is the line-of-sight separation to an astronomical object, measured in Mpc.

event_rate.description: Event rate is the volumetric rate of transient events, measured in Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹.

rotation_measure.description: Rotation measure quantifies Faraday rotation of polarized light due to magnetic fields and free electrons along the line of sight, measured in rad m⁻².

scattering_timescale.description: Scattering timescale is the temporal broadening of a pulse due to multi-path scattering in the interstellar medium, measured in ms.

spectral_index.description: Spectral index describes the slope of the flux density spectrum assuming a power-law, a dimensionless quantity.

magnetic_field.description: Magnetic field is the strength of the magnetic field in the source or propagation medium, measured in G.

electron_density.description: Electron density is the number of free electrons per unit volume, measured in cm⁻³.
